baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated negation coordinates the plural darknesses at word 2 with the singular light at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: The number asymmetry permits many modes of displacement and obstruction to stand against one disclosing field without reducing either side to a mere color.

activation_trace.role: Putting something at the wrong time or physical place turns the plural darknesses into proliferating dislocations.
Withholding or confining a right makes darkness function as blocked access as well as low visibility.
Illumination supplies the singular condition in which the many dislocations can be exposed.

changed_reading.before: Darkness and light are simply two visual states.
changed_reading.after: The ayah contrasts many ways of displacing or withholding with one condition of disclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular light at word 4 is opposed to plural darknesses under a repeated, balanced negation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Light is actionable legibility: a marker, boundary, or clear track that permits orientation, while darknesses multiply the ways access and direction can be lost.

activation_trace.role: The withholding branch supplies the obstruction against which navigable access matters.
A conspicuous road or boundary marker makes light a public aid to orientation.
A clear projecting groove or mark sharpens light into a readable track rather than diffuse brightness.

changed_reading.before: Light is an undifferentiated symbol of goodness.
changed_reading.after: Light is a usable orientation system that reveals tracks and limits where darkness blocks passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus contrast becomes hydraulic and social: darknesses are closures that arrest a beneficial flow, while light is an opened passage through which what is given can move.

activation_trace.role: Withholding a due right anchors darkness in blocked circulation.
The visible marker gives an opened flow a direction rather than leaving it diffuse.
The widening of a closed entrance supplies the aperture through which mercy can pass.
Grasping and confining supplies the contrary operation of arresting that passage.
Sending forth supplies motion after release and completes the open-versus-held mechanism.

structural_cues: 35:2 mirrors opening with no possible holder and holding with no possible sender around the movement of mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, confinement, and sending; I map their flow relation onto darkness and light, while the live alternative is that 35:2 describes sovereignty without an optical analogy.

changed_reading.before: Light marks a route while darkness obstructs it.
changed_reading.after: The contrast diagnoses whether beneficent movement is opened and directed or multiply arrested.

context_deltas.mechanism: Brightness and attractiveness cannot by themselves identify light: a polished appearance can conceal badness and make perception classify it as good, so true light must disclose rather than merely shine.

activation_trace.role: The branch of making an affair confusing places counterfeit disclosure inside the light-root inventory itself.
Deception by what glitters but does not endure supplies the mechanism of false radiance.
Making a thing appear beautiful supplies the surface treatment that can counterfeit light.
Intrinsic ugliness supplies the concealed condition beneath the attractive surface.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the perceptual site where the false classification occurs.

structural_cues: 35:8 places beautification before seeing a bad act as good and then immediately contrasts misguidance with guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies glittering deception, beautification, badness, and mis-seeing; I infer a test that separates disclosure from attractive glare, while an alternative is that the light pair remains wholly independent of deceptive appearance.

changed_reading.before: Whatever looks bright and attractive belongs naturally on the light side.
changed_reading.after: Apparent luminosity may be counterfeit; light is the capacity to reveal a thing's quality accurately.

context_deltas.mechanism: A repeated non-equivalence can preserve real difference without making one domain wholly fruitless: unlike waters still share a substrate and yield provision, so the focus contrast need not authorize an exhaustive good-versus-worthless partition.

activation_trace.role: Multiple wrong placements keep the darkness side internally differentiated rather than uniformly empty.
Illumination remains genuinely distinct without requiring every benefit to be exclusive to its side.
Explicit comparison and non-equivalence supply the same relational frame used around the focus.
Shared breadth supplies a common medium across the two unlike waters.
Fresh sweet water supplies one genuinely distinct quality within the comparison.
Salinity supplies the contrary quality without erasing the common aquatic field.
Edible provision supplies a benefit explicitly drawn from both non-equal domains.

structural_cues: 35:12 first denies equality between the two seas, then assigns eating and ornament extraction to each of them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prior non-equality formula plus shared yields; I carry that relational grammar into 35:20, while the live alternative is that the sea comparison has no limiting force on the later light contrast.

changed_reading.before: Non-equivalence makes the two sides exhaustive moral opposites with no shared affordances.
changed_reading.after: Darkness and light remain non-equivalent, yet non-equivalence alone does not prove that one side is wholly barren or without local yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Darkness and light are distinct regimes with a moving interface: night and day enter into one another and continue toward a term, so non-equivalence does not entail sealed, static substances.

activation_trace.role: Illumination anchors one phase of the changing boundary.
One thing entering inside another supplies permeability in both directions.
Night and its darkness instantiate the dark phase without making it immobile.
Day opening through radiance instantiates the light phase as an unfolding interval.
Continuous running supplies temporal motion rather than a frozen opposition.

structural_cues: 35:13 repeats the insertion verb with night and day reversed, then assigns the sun and moon motion to a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal insertion and ongoing motion; I infer a moving light-dark interface, while an alternative is that cosmic cycling and the focus's evaluative contrast operate at separate levels.

changed_reading.before: Darkness and light are fixed containers with an impermeable border.
changed_reading.after: They are non-equal but interpenetrating phases whose boundary moves through time.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair is the middle hinge of a functional ladder: discernment or its loss changes orientation, orientation changes exposure or shelter, and those conditions culminate in responsive life or inert death.

activation_trace.role: Blocked access lets darkness connect impaired perception to deprivation of shelter and response.
A visible waymarker lets light connect perception to directed movement toward a viable condition.
Comparison between two things supplies the non-equivalence relation governing the adjacent series.
Blindness of inner perception makes the first contrast epistemic rather than merely ophthalmic.
Inner sight supplies the discerning capacity that light can operationalize.
Protective cover turns the next pair into a question of inhabitable shelter.
Dry thirst in the body gives exposed heat a concrete cost.
Life as benefit and good supplies the viable endpoint of discernment and shelter.
Stillness and extinction supply the contrary endpoint of unresponsiveness.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes life visible as responsive reception.

structural_cues: 35:19-22 place 35:20 second in four adjacent pairs: blind/seeing, darknesses/light, shade/scorching heat, and living/dead.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered series of capacities and conditions; I infer causal links from discernment through orientation and shelter to responsiveness, while the live alternative is a rhetorical list of analogies without a single causal ladder.

changed_reading.before: The focus is an isolated moral metaphor about darkness and light.
changed_reading.after: It is the hinge by which failed or successful perception becomes an environment and then a mode of life or nonresponse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Light is not identical with public exposure: an illuminating text makes truth legible, while valid expenditure can remain hidden or be manifest. Illumination concerns orientation and intelligibility, not compulsory visibility of every good act.

activation_trace.role: A route marker anchors light in shared orientation rather than exposure for its own sake.
Ordered letters and a written object supply a transmissible medium for illumination.
Clarity and visible projection make the book readable and directive.
Money going outward supplies one good action tested across hidden and public modes.
Concealment in the interior shows that goodness can operate without public display.
Manifest appearance supplies the equally valid public mode without monopolizing light.

structural_cues: 35:25 attaches the illuminating quality to a book, while 35:29 coordinates secret and public expenditure under one hoped-for outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an illuminating written medium and one act performed secretly or openly; I infer that light names discernibility rather than publicity, while an alternative is that the two passages address unrelated kinds of visibility.

changed_reading.before: Light means that every good thing is externally exposed and darkness means concealment.
changed_reading.after: Light makes truth and direction legible, yet an act can participate in that order while remaining appropriately hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: Singular light need not flatten plurality into sameness. It can be the common revealing condition under which fruits, mountain tracks, living beings, and even intense blackness become distinctly legible.

activation_trace.role: A clear projecting track makes illumination difference-revealing rather than homogenizing.
Delivered water supplies the common input from which differentiated visible products emerge.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the transition into visibility.
Kinds distinguished as colors supply plurality that disclosure preserves.
Visible lines and tracks in the mountains materialize legible differentiation.
Blackness as the visible silhouette of a thing shows that dark color itself can be disclosed rather than equated with invisibility.
A thing becoming uncovered to a knower links visible differentiation to discernment.

structural_cues: 35:27 moves from one descent of water to differently colored fruits and mountain bands, and 35:28 extends differing colors to living beings before naming knowers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, varied colors, visible tracks, black forms, and knowing; I infer illumination as their shared condition of legibility, while an alternative is a creation-diversity sequence with no implied optics.

changed_reading.before: One light opposes plurality by replacing it with uniform brightness.
changed_reading.after: One light can preserve and reveal many differences, including the visible contours of blackness itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Darkness is not only an external camp opposed to a community of light. Self-wronging, moderation, and precedence can coexist as differentiated positions within one selected body that inherits the same book.

activation_trace.role: A grievance that calls for redress makes darkness a reparable relation rather than a fixed identity.
Transmission of a book or knowledge gives all three positions a shared inheritance.
Selection establishes that the self-wronging figure remains inside the chosen group.
Putting something out of its proper place supplies the internal failure named in the first subgroup.
The thing's own self or essence locates that displacement inward rather than solely against outsiders.
A middle measure supplies a second position on the same internal gradient.
Advancing ahead supplies the third position and turns the categories into movement rather than essences.

structural_cues: 35:32 repeats 'among them' for self-wronging, moderate, and foremost figures after one act of selection and one inherited book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared selection and inheritance plus three internal positions; I infer that the focus's plural darknesses can name conditions within a light-bearing collective, while an alternative keeps the focus pair as a strict division between populations.

changed_reading.before: Darknesses identify a wholly external group, while light identifies an internally uniform chosen group.
changed_reading.after: Darkness can be self-directed and internal to a selected, book-inheriting community whose members occupy different trajectories.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mapped light root also appears as fire and carries a blazing-fire branch. Radiant energy is therefore not sufficient to define the positive side; its mode, effect, and relation to guidance matter.

activation_trace.role: Illumination supplies the focus's ordinary positive-facing radiance.
Blazing fire supplies a radiant but punitive realization from the same mapped root inventory.

structural_cues: 35:36 places the fire occurrence inside a sentence of neither completed death nor eased punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the shared mapped root and its fire branch; I infer that radiance alone cannot carry the focus's valuation, while a live alternative treats fire and light as morphologically related but semantically separate lexemes.

changed_reading.before: Any radiance is inherently the beneficial light opposed to darkness.
changed_reading.after: Beneficial light is disclosed and guiding radiance, not brightness or combustion as such.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a watery dental gleam crosses the apparent polarity from inside the darkness-side root; it remains anchored directly in the focus inventory, but downstream prose should label it a lexical-material resonance rather than claim that the ayah equates darkness with light.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural darkness term at word 2 bears the root whose inventory contains the glint branch and stands directly opposite light at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A water-like gleam on teeth embeds a point of brightness inside the darkness-side lexical field.
Ordinary illumination supplies the pole that the internal glint unexpectedly approaches without erasing the contrast.

changed_reading.before: Darkness is a perfectly lightless semantic container.
changed_reading.after: The darkness-side root can carry a local glint, making the opposition sharp but lexically porous.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The botanical transfer is cross-domain and therefore surprising, but both images are direct branches of the two focus roots and produce a coherent contrast; downstream prose should present it as an imagistic model, not as the lexical meaning of either noun in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two coordinated focus roots each contain a tree-related branch, one at word 2 and one at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A tree whose long shoots overrun its base makes plural darknesses resemble uncontrolled extension beyond origin.
A tree's visible flowering makes singular light resemble disclosed, articulated growth.

changed_reading.before: The opposition is only optical and static.
changed_reading.after: It can image two growth dynamics: proliferating overreach versus growth that flowers into visibility.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the flight or recoil branch of the light root through a later, separately rooted recoil response; it remains anchored in the focus branch inventory and the warning sequence, but downstream prose should qualify it as phonetic-semantic activation rather than ordinary morphology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The singular light at word 4 has an inventory branch of recoil and low stability.

activation_trace.role: Recoil from what is ugly makes light an ethical withdrawal or an unstable availability, not a possession.
Gentle direction toward a true path supplies the guidance that the hearers claimed they would accept.
Drawing away and increasing distance supplies the actual recoil when warning arrives.

changed_reading.before: Light is a stable object simply present before a viewer.
changed_reading.after: Light may name a demanded recoil from ugliness or a guidance from which the addressed subject can recoil, leaving access unstable.

strongest_changes: The adjacent pairs turn darkness/light into the hinge between discernment, shelter, vitality, and responsive hearing.
The earlier unequal seas show that non-equivalence does not by itself imply total barrenness or absence of shared yield.
Reciprocal insertion of night and day changes a static binary into a moving boundary between distinct regimes.
Beautified wrongdoing and glittering deception force a distinction between revealing light and counterfeit visibility.
The self-wronging member of a selected book-inheriting group relocates darkness from an external identity to an internal, potentially reparable condition.
summary.what_was_special: The very short focus became a relational hinge rather than a slogan: plural darknesses activated obstruction, dislocation, inner differentiation, and overgrowth, while singular light activated wayfinding, legibility, truthful disclosure, and difference-preserving visibility. The context repeatedly complicated the polarity without dissolving it.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal ladder from perception through shelter to vitality is abductive; the adjacent pairs may be parallel analogies rather than one mechanism.
The shared-yield constraint from the sea comparison may not transfer fully to the later light contrast.
The fire, recoil, glint, and botanical activations are branch-valid but remain lexically distant and require explicit qualification.
Plural darknesses versus singular light may carry rhetorical number agreement rather than the mechanistic asymmetry proposed here.
